raw_context:
MedPlus Health Services
sells and distributes a massive inventory of
thousands of branded prescription drugs, over-the-counter (OTC) medicines, and fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) from major national and international pharmaceutical and wellness manufacturers
, alongside an expanding line of its own private-label and store-brand generic alternatives.
Third-Party Brands & Manufacturers
Ethical & Branded Pharmaceuticals:
Sources products from virtually all major Indian and global pharmaceutical companies (such as Cipla, Dr. Reddy's, Sun Pharma, Abbott, and GlaxoSmithKline) representing thousands of established medical brands.
FMCG & Wellness Brands:
Carries leading consumer, personal care, baby care, and nutritional brands spanning major commercial manufacturers.
MedPlus Private-Label & Store Generics
Contract Manufacturers:
Partners with reputed third-party manufacturing facilities like
Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd
and
Windlas Biotech Ltd
to produce its off-patent store generics and private-label formulations.
MedPlusMart
Store-Brand Lines:
Sells budget-friendly private-label medications (such as
Monterite
Telmsvan
, and
Rosumep
variants) as well as non-pharmaceutical private labels like
EatRite
(food and nutritional supplements) and personal care lines like
Avelia
and
Urbania
